Compliance Matters!

From the ORA eTraining module "Post Award Quick Guide" (lesson 5 of 9).
Other Matters of Compliance
Heading
Compliance concerns MUST be brought to the attention of the Office of Research Administration (ORA), as soon as possible. If the Internal Routing Form has not yet been completed, asking much of these same questions, please be certain to do so immediately.
Please review the list below and check the items that you have included in your budget/budget justification. There may be items that could be allowable per the funding opportunity announcement, but not budgeted for in your award; you may choose to check them as well.
Category Questions to Consider Export controls Does your project (including research personnel, subrecipients, or contractors) anticipate utilizing foreign national(s) in the performance of the award? A foreign national is defined as any person who is not a U.S. citizen by birth or naturalization. Export controls Is this project receiving any funding from a foreign government or institution? Is any sensitive information being shared with a foreign government or institution? Conflict of Interest Do you have any conflict of interest? Cost share Does the project require cost share? Renovation Does the project need non-grant-funded resources, renovation, construction, or space? Unfunded items Does the project require the purchase or maintenance of equipment or furniture NOT included in the proposal? Unfunded items Does the project require expanded utility (or network) services to support it? Unfunded items Does the project include additional personnel requiring funds NOT included in the proposal or likely to require support of space AFTER the project? Human studies Does the project include human subjects research? If yes, has protocol been reviewed by IRB? Animal studies Does the project include animal research? If yes, has protocol been reviewed by IACUC? Radioactive material Does the project include planned or potential use of radioactive materials? (The PI must be a permit holder or authorized under a current permit.) Ionizing radiation Does the project include planned or potential use of (a) ionizing radiation device?
If your project includes items in the table above, please email the information to ask.ora@morgan.edu along with a copy of the Notice of Award for further instruction.
Complete the content above before moving on.
Reporting Requirements
Your Notice of Award (NOA) will detail the reporting needs of your research project. It is your responsibility to work with Restricted Funds Accounting (RFA) to ensure that the appropriate financial reports are generated and sent to the funding agency. Review your NOA and think about how you can get a head start on your reporting requirements. Action Frequency Responsible person Submitted via Programmatic report Financial report Other reports Other reports
Knowledge check: Which specific groups need to review your project if it includes both human subjects AND animal research?
  - OHR & RFA  [incorrect]
  - IRB & IACUC  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - ORA & RFA  [incorrect]
  - HHS & USDA  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job! The IRB will review your project protocol compliance for human subjects research and IACUC will review your compliance with respect to using animals in research.
  If incorrect: While these other offices and groups may be involved in your project at one time or another, they are not actively involved in reviewing your project compliance with respect to human and animal research.
